How To / FAQ V6 + Mercenary V4

Quick guide, compact.

What's new in V6 + Mercenary V4?
  • Improved claim & block state flow
  • Pirate & Farming boosts with clearer state handling
  • Better claim preview flow
  • Mercenary V4 with permanent slot unlocks
  • Duration-based protection pricing (1–7 days)
  • Immediate points on start + completion rewards
  • Attack execution on Pyramid Map (more stable)
How does minting work?

Choose coordinates, select payment, mint. Then reveal → farm → attack.

What does reveal do?

Exposes rarity and production rates. Only possible once per block.

How does Mercenary Protection V4 work?

1 slot free. Slots 2+3 unlockable permanently with resources. Protection 1–7 days: 20% / 30% / 50%. INPI payments receive rank-based discount.

How do Defender Points work?
  • Set 1–2d = +2 · 3–5d = +5 · 6–7d = +10
  • Completed protection grants bonus
  • Higher ranks = better INPI discount
Slot unlocks?

Slot 2: 1000 Oil · 500 Lemons · 100 Iron
Slot 3: 500 Oil · 100 Lemons · 100 Iron · 50 Gold · 25 Crystal · 5 Mysterium

Permanent per wallet.

How do attacks work?

Heavy flow on Pyramid Map. In the Game page you can see active attacks, open/cancel them, and buy Pirate Boost.

Boosts?

Farm Boost: 100 INPI/day · +25% · max 10d (farm window 7d)
Pirate Boost: 100 PIT/day · +25 percentage points steal · max 10d

What is cleanup for?

Clears expired protection slots. Rewards depend on rank (Iron, Copper, Obsidian).

What is the exchange for?

Swap INPI ↔ PIT. Rate and pool status shown live.
